title: Motorcycle LED Headlight – Auxiliary & Fog Light 12V
descriptionHtml:
Better vision and visibility on the bike

On dark roads the motorcycle's standard lights often aren't enough. Better lighting means you both see more and are seen better.

Strong LED light as an auxiliary light

This LED headlight works as an auxiliary light, fog light or spotlight. It gives a strong, clear light and fits most 12V motorcycles.

Features

  • Works as an auxiliary light, fog light or spotlight
  • Strong, clear LED light
  • Fits 12V
  • Durable and weather-resistant
  • Great for motorcycles, mopeds and ATVs

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
